entities.summary: Tacky's Rebellion, a transformative movement in Jamaica (1700–1807). Emerged from Sugar Plantation Economy. Catalyzed First Maroon War peace treaty — Captain Cudjoe and the British 1739 and Tacky's Rebellion — largest enslaved uprising in the British Caribbean, 1760.
